items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That was Irving Muller's thing, wasn't it? [INTERVIEWEE] I have a book on that. That was Jimmy Evans. Jack Teagarden was the star.

ctx.x: And I used to let a lot of the bands use our sleeper bus. Run into a band like Hawkins, Erskine Hawkins and all of them. They wouldn't have nowhere to sleep during the way. I'd be coming through and while we was playing, I'd say, well, man, use our sleeping bus. Facilities on that and everything. Big trailer bus.
Well, what was this thing then -- it says, '47, toured with the Cavalcade of Jazz. That was Irving Muller's thing, wasn't it?
I have a book on that. That was Jimmy Evans. Jack Teagarden was the star.
